{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check status values
print(f"Unique status values: {df['status'].unique().tolist()}")"}
